problems.negativeLoad: The weight cannot be below zero.
problems.durationRequired: Enter the time: minutes, seconds or both.

own.title: Your exercises
own.empty: No exercises of your own yet.
own.name: Name

own.confirmDeleteUnused: Delete "{{name}}"? It has no entries yet.
own.nameTaken: There is already an exercise with this name.
own.kindFixed: This does not change: the exercise's entries are already stored this way. To record something else, add a new exercise.
own.directionHint: The records and goals of this exercise will be judged by the new rule at once.

counters.title: Counters
counters.soberHint: Once there is a date, the sobriety achievements appear.

camp.title: Camp look
camp.subtitle: Knight, tent, sky
camp.aboutPremiumHint: What is in it and what it costs

backup.title: Backup
backup.saveBody: The file holds everything you entered: results, your own exercises, weight and measurements, goals, counters and the look of the camp. Language and skin stay on the phone.
backup.saved: The file {{name}} is ready. Keep it somewhere that will not be lost with the phone.
backup.saveFailed: Could not save the file. Try again.
backup.restoreBody: What is in the file is added to what is already here. Nothing is deleted. If the same entry is both on the phone and in the file, the one from the file stays.

problems.notJson: This file does not look like a Record backup.
problems.notBackup: This is a data file, but not a Record backup.
problems.newerVersion: This copy was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.
problems.damaged: The file is damaged, so nothing was taken from it. Where it goes wrong: {{where}}

backup.restoreButton: Add the data from the file
backup.restored: Done. Entries on the phone now: {{total}}
backup.restoreFailed: Could not add the data. Nothing on the phone has changed.

recordImport.title: Bring over from Record
recordImport.how1: In the old Record, open the menu and press "{{button}}". It saves a file named like "{{file}}".
recordImport.how2: Choose that file here. Before anything is brought over you will see what was found in it.
recordImport.limits: Record's file has only the date, the exercise and the result. It has no notes, no video links and no body weight, so there is nowhere to bring those from.
recordImport.again: The file can be brought over again: only new rows are added. Anything you corrected or deleted here stays as it is.
recordImport.notRecordCsv: This is not a file from "{{button}}": its first line must be "{{header}}".
recordImport.exercisesHint: The name and which way is better can be changed later in "{{screen}}".

issues.keptAsText: Will stay as text, because no numbers could be read: {{total}}
issues.looselyRead: Numbers read, the rest of the text kept beside them: {{total}}
issues.distanceMissing: A run or sprint without a distance: {{total}}
issues.schemeAssumed: A shuttle run without a scheme, taken as 10×10 m: {{total}}
issues.singleRepAssumed: A bench press with a weight only, taken as one rep: {{total}}

recordImport.skipped: No date or no result, so not brought over: {{total}}
recordImport.brokenLines: Lines that could not be made out: {{total}} (numbers: {{lines}})
recordImport.nothingNew: The file has no new entries.
recordImport.done: Done. Entries added: {{added}}. On the phone now: {{total}}
recordImport.failed: Could not bring them over. Nothing on the phone has changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unitsHint: Distances are always in kilometres and metres: that is how the running disciplines are named.
settings.partsHint: Body parts beyond the built-in ones
settings.backupHint: Save your data to a file or restore it from one
settings.recordImportHint: Entries from the old app, from its export file

support.title: Support the author
support.intro: Record is free and has no ads. If it helps you, this is where you can thank the author.
support.premiumAlt: The camp dressed in the premium set
support.premiumBody_one: {{count}} item for the camp that opens no other way:
support.premiumBody_other: {{count}} items for the camp that open no other way:
support.premiumSame: Everything else in the app is the same with it or without it.
support.terms: The subscription renews every month until you cancel it. You can cancel any time in Google Play; the month already paid for runs to its end.
support.active: Your subscription is active. Thank you!
support.premiumNotSold: The subscription is not in Google Play yet.
support.tipsBody: A one-off payment of your choice. It opens nothing; it simply thanks the author.
support.tipsNotSold: Tips are not in Google Play yet.
support.restoreHint: If the subscription did not show up by itself, for example after reinstalling.

store.none: This build sells nothing. Purchases work only in the app installed from Google Play.
store.failed: Google Play is not answering. Check the internet connection and that the phone is signed in to a Google account.

notices.premiumOn: Premium is on. The new items are waiting in Camp look.
notices.pending: The payment is still being processed. Once Google Play confirms it, everything turns on by itself.
notices.nothingToRestore: This Google account has no active subscription.
notices.tipCleared: The previous tip is complete. You can give another one now.
notices.network: No connection to Google Play. Check the internet connection and try again.
notices.unavailable: Google Play does not sell this right now. Try again later.
notices.billing: Google Play is not taking payments right now. Try again later.
notices.failed: That did not work. Try again.

dev.title: For development
dev.body: Shown only in development. Opens the premium set without buying it, until the app restarts.

startup.failedBody: The app could not open the database with your records and has not changed anything in it. Try again; if that does not help, close the app and open it again.
startup.tooNewBody: This data was saved by a newer version of the app than this one. Update the app to open it.
